title: Easter Story Introduction
prompt: Introduce the Easter story in your own words.
hint: Talk about love, courage, and the special gift Easter represents.
sample: The Easter story is about Jesus' love and courage, and the gift of new life.

ja.prompt: イースターの物語を自分の言葉で紹介してください。
ja.hint: 愛や勇気、イースターが表す特別な贈り物について話しましょう。
ja.sample: イースターの物語は、イエスの愛と勇気、新しい命の贈り物についてです。

local.prompt: Introduce the Easter story in your own words.
local.hint: Talk about love, courage, and the special gift Easter represents.
local.sample: The Easter story is about Jesus' love and courage, and the gift of new life.

zh.prompt: 用你自己的話介紹復活節的故事。
zh.hint: 談談愛、勇氣，以及復活節代表的特別禮物。
zh.sample: 復活節的故事是關於耶穌的愛與勇氣，以及新生命的禮物。

en.prompt: Introduce the Easter story in your own words.
en.hint: Talk about love, courage, and the special gift Easter represents.
en.sample: The Easter story is about Jesus' love and courage, and the gift of new life.

title: Jesus' Entry to Jerusalem
prompt: Describe Jesus' entry into Jerusalem and how people reacted.
hint: Mention the donkey, palm branches, and the crowd's feelings.
sample: Jesus rode a donkey into Jerusalem, and people waved palm branches happily.

ja.prompt: イエスがエルサレムに入る様子と人々の反応を説明してください。
ja.hint: ロバ、ヤシの枝、群衆の気持ちについて触れましょう。
ja.sample: イエスはロバに乗ってエルサレムに入り、人々はヤシの枝を振って喜びました。

local.prompt: Describe Jesus' entry into Jerusalem and how people reacted.
local.hint: Mention the donkey, palm branches, and the crowd's feelings.
local.sample: Jesus rode a donkey into Jerusalem, and people waved palm branches happily.

zh.prompt: 描述耶穌進入耶路撒冷的情景以及人們的反應。
zh.hint: 提到驢子、棕櫚枝和群眾的感受。
zh.sample: 耶穌騎著驢子進入耶路撒冷，人們高興地揮舞著棕櫚枝。

en.prompt: Describe Jesus' entry into Jerusalem and how people reacted.
en.hint: Mention the donkey, palm branches, and the crowd's feelings.
en.sample: Jesus rode a donkey into Jerusalem, and people waved palm branches happily.

title: The Last Supper Promise
prompt: Explain the promise Jesus made during the Last Supper.
hint: Talk about Jesus sharing bread and wine and his promise to return.
sample: Jesus shared bread and wine, saying he would go away but come back to life.

ja.prompt: 最後の晩餐でイエスがした約束を説明してください。
ja.hint: イエスがパンとぶどう酒を分け合い、戻ってくる約束をしたことについて話しましょう。
ja.sample: イエスはパンとぶどう酒を分け合い、しばらく行くがまた生き返ると約束しました。

local.prompt: Explain the promise Jesus made during the Last Supper.
local.hint: Talk about Jesus sharing bread and wine and his promise to return.
local.sample: Jesus shared bread and wine, saying he would go away but come back to life.

zh.prompt: 說明耶穌在最後的晚餐中所做的承諾。
zh.hint: 談談耶穌分享餅和酒，以及他將會回來的承諾。
zh.sample: 耶穌分享餅和酒，說他會離開但會復活回來。

en.prompt: Explain the promise Jesus made during the Last Supper.
en.hint: Talk about Jesus sharing bread and wine and his promise to return.
en.sample: Jesus shared bread and wine, saying he would go away but come back to life.

title: Jesus' Prayer and Arrest
prompt: Describe Jesus' feelings in the garden and what happened next.
hint: Mention Jesus praying, feeling afraid, and being arrested by soldiers.
sample: Jesus prayed in the garden feeling afraid, then soldiers came and arrested him.

ja.prompt: イエスが庭で祈っていた時の気持ちとその後に起こったことを説明してください。
ja.hint: イエスが恐れて祈り、兵士たちに逮捕されたことに触れましょう。
ja.sample: イエスは庭で恐れながら祈っていると、兵士たちが来て逮捕されました。

local.prompt: Describe Jesus' feelings in the garden and what happened next.
local.hint: Mention Jesus praying, feeling afraid, and being arrested by soldiers.
local.sample: Jesus prayed in the garden feeling afraid, then soldiers came and arrested him.

zh.prompt: 描述耶穌在園中祈禱時的感受以及接下來發生的事。
zh.hint: 提到耶穌祈禱、感到害怕，然後被士兵逮捕。
zh.sample: 耶穌在園中祈禱時感到害怕，接著士兵來逮捕了他。

en.prompt: Describe Jesus' feelings in the garden and what happened next.
en.hint: Mention Jesus praying, feeling afraid, and being arrested by soldiers.
en.sample: Jesus prayed in the garden feeling afraid, then soldiers came and arrested him.

title: Jesus' Sacrifice on the Cross
prompt: Explain why Jesus chose to stay on the cross and what it means for us.
hint: Talk about Jesus taking punishment for our wrongs and forgiving those who hurt him.
sample: Jesus stayed on the cross to take the punishment for our sins and forgave those who hurt him.

ja.prompt: なぜイエスが十字架に留まることを選んだのか、そしてそれが私たちにとって何を意味するのか説明してください。
ja.hint: イエスが私たちの罪の罰を受け、傷つけた人々を許したことについて話しましょう。
ja.sample: イエスは私たちの罪の罰を受けるために十字架に留まり、傷つけた人々を許しました。

local.prompt: Explain why Jesus chose to stay on the cross and what it means for us.
local.hint: Talk about Jesus taking punishment for our wrongs and forgiving those who hurt him.
local.sample: Jesus stayed on the cross to take the punishment for our sins and forgave those who hurt him.

zh.prompt: 說明耶穌為何選擇留在十字架上，以及這對我們的意義。
zh.hint: 談談耶穌承擔我們的罪罰並原諒傷害他的人。
zh.sample: 耶穌留在十字架上，承擔我們的罪罰，並原諒了傷害他的人。

en.prompt: Explain why Jesus chose to stay on the cross and what it means for us.
en.hint: Talk about Jesus taking punishment for our wrongs and forgiving those who hurt him.
en.sample: Jesus stayed on the cross to take the punishment for our sins and forgave those who hurt him.

title: Jesus' Resurrection
prompt: Describe what happened on Easter Sunday morning.
hint: Mention the angel rolling the stone away and Jesus coming back to life.
sample: An angel rolled the stone away, and Jesus was alive again as he promised.

ja.prompt: イースターの日曜日の朝に起こったことを説明してください。
ja.hint: 天使が石を転がし、イエスが約束通り生き返ったことに触れましょう。
ja.sample: 天使が石を転がし、イエスは約束通り生き返りました。

local.prompt: Describe what happened on Easter Sunday morning.
local.hint: Mention the angel rolling the stone away and Jesus coming back to life.
local.sample: An angel rolled the stone away, and Jesus was alive again as he promised.

zh.prompt: 描述復活節星期天早晨發生的事。
zh.hint: 提到天使推開石頭，耶穌復活了。
zh.sample: 天使推開了石頭，耶穌如約復活了。

en.prompt: Describe what happened on Easter Sunday morning.
en.hint: Mention the angel rolling the stone away and Jesus coming back to life.
en.sample: An angel rolled the stone away, and Jesus was alive again as he promised.

title: Jesus' Promise of Hope
prompt: Explain the hope Jesus gave to his friends after his resurrection.
hint: Talk about Jesus showing he is alive and giving peace and hope.
sample: Jesus appeared to his friends to show he was alive and gave them hope and peace.

ja.prompt: イエスが復活後に友達に与えた希望を説明してください。
ja.hint: イエスが生きていることを示し、平和と希望を与えたことについて話しましょう。
ja.sample: イエスは友達に現れて生きていることを示し、希望と平和を与えました。

local.prompt: Explain the hope Jesus gave to his friends after his resurrection.
local.hint: Talk about Jesus showing he is alive and giving peace and hope.
local.sample: Jesus appeared to his friends to show he was alive and gave them hope and peace.

zh.prompt: 說明耶穌復活後給朋友們的希望。
zh.hint: 談談耶穌顯現活著，並帶來平安與希望。
zh.sample: 耶穌向朋友顯現，證明他活著，並給他們希望與平安。

en.prompt: Explain the hope Jesus gave to his friends after his resurrection.
en.hint: Talk about Jesus showing he is alive and giving peace and hope.
en.sample: Jesus appeared to his friends to show he was alive and gave them hope and peace.

title: Jesus' Love and Prayer
prompt: Write a short prayer thanking Jesus for his love and courage.
hint: Express gratitude for Jesus being alive and watching over us.
sample: Dear Jesus, thank you for loving me and being brave. Help me feel your peace tonight.

ja.prompt: イエスの愛と勇気に感謝する短い祈りを書いてください。
ja.hint: イエスが生きていて私たちを見守ってくれることに感謝の気持ちを表しましょう。
ja.sample: 親愛なるイエス様、私を愛し勇気を持ってくださってありがとうございます。今夜、あなたの平和を感じられますように。

local.prompt: Write a short prayer thanking Jesus for his love and courage.
local.hint: Express gratitude for Jesus being alive and watching over us.
local.sample: Dear Jesus, thank you for loving me and being brave. Help me feel your peace tonight.

zh.prompt: 寫一段簡短的禱告，感謝耶穌的愛與勇氣。
zh.hint: 表達對耶穌活著並守護我們的感謝。
zh.sample: 親愛的耶穌，感謝你愛我並勇敢。請幫助我今晚感受到你的平安。

en.prompt: Write a short prayer thanking Jesus for his love and courage.
en.hint: Express gratitude for Jesus being alive and watching over us.
en.sample: Dear Jesus, thank you for loving me and being brave. Help me feel your peace tonight.
